title: Sentence-BERT: Sentence Embeddings Using Siamese BERT-Networks
description: BERT's cross-encoder setup requires running inference for every pair of sentences — O(N²) cost for semantic search over a corpus. SBERT uses a Siamese network to produce fixed-size sentence embeddings that can be compared with cosine similarity, enabling O(N) search. Still the most used framework for dense retrieval embeddings.
